workflows.external_systems: simulated: local mock ticketing (8101) and service desk (8105)

apex-industrial.step: sign in as engineer, supervisor, administrator and auditor
engineer analyses a fault report with a structured observation (HTTP 201)
the observation is stored as a submitted observation awaiting verification (class C, VALIDATED, not used for priority)
asset is registered
engineer cannot verify (403 insufficient_role)
auditor cannot verify (403 insufficient_role)
another tenant's supervisor gets 404 (tenant isolation)
another tenant's engineer cannot read the incident (404)
supervisor verifies; the server returns HUMAN_VERIFIED, class D, eligible
priority comes from the server: P3 -> P2 (verification block says P3 -> P2)
a repeated decision is refused (409)
the creator cannot verify their own incident's measurement (403 separation_of_duties)
engineer drafts a ticket (201, DRAFT)
approval requested (PENDING_APPROVAL)
the author cannot approve (403)
supervisor approves
the worker submits it to the (simulated) external system: SUBMITTED with an external id
the audit log shows the whole chain
document maintenance_log.csv is listed and searchable before deletion
an engineer cannot delete a document (403)
another tenant's supervisor cannot delete it or see it (404)
supervisor deletes: logically deleted at once, cleanup pending or already running
the deleted document is gone from the listing, direct access (404) and search
the worker removed the content and verified it (cleanup completed), a repeated delete is idempotent
the audit log holds the deletion and the cleanup without content

ingestion.fault: simulated: the embedding step raises while the fault switch file exists (scripts/fault_boot.py); the retry logic is exercised against that failure mode

apex-industrial.step: a supported document uploads synchronously (201) as before
the upload left a COMPLETED durable ingestion job with its outcome and chunk count
the content is retrievable once indexed
during the SIMULATED embedding outage the upload keeps its contract: 503 embedding_unavailable with Retry-After
a RETRY_PENDING job with a sanitised error and a next attempt time exists
bounded retry then recovery: COMPLETED after 3 attempts (limit 5), document created, now retrievable
repeating the upload afterwards is a duplicate: nothing is stored twice
an engineer cannot reprocess (403)
a supervisor queues reprocessing (202)
replacement generation activated (1 to 2); retrieval serves the document once, no duplicates
another tenant cannot see this tenant's jobs (404, indistinguishable from unknown)
another tenant's supervisor cannot reprocess it (404)
deletion while a reprocessing job is queued cancels it (document_deleted); the content never returns
after recovery the cancelled job does not run: the document stays deleted, unsearchable, not reprocessable (404)
the audit log records job creation, retry, completion, reprocessing, cancellation and cleanup

rest.fault: controlled injection in the records mock (a 503 burst after the first page): the retry logic is exercised against that failure, it is not a real upstream outage
rest.records_source: mock-services/records (separate local process, X-API-Key required; run-only key not recorded)

apex-industrial.step: the administrator registers a REST records connector (cursor pagination) through the public API
an invalid connector configuration (an absolute URL as the path) is rejected at creation (422)
an engineer cannot start a synchronisation (403)
another tenant's administrator gets 404 for this connector
a supervisor starts a synchronisation: 202 with a durable QUEUED sync job
the worker pulled every page and ingested every record: COMPLETED, 7 records created over 3 pages
the records mock saw real authenticated paginated requests from the connector
the synchronised content is retrievable by this tenant, with the source record id as provenance
the other tenant's retrieval never returns this tenant's records (searching the same words)
the other tenant cannot read this tenant's sync job (404)
a repeated synchronisation is safe: every record unchanged, nothing created twice
a changed source record becomes a new document version, unchanged ones are skipped
the update is retrievable
a connector limited to 2 requests per second spaces its real requests (3 pages took 1.3 s)
without probe=true the health endpoint makes no live request (unchanged behaviour)
probe=true makes one bounded real request to the source: ok in 28.8 ms (nothing ingested)
an engineer cannot run the probe (403)
a controlled upstream failure is retried with backoff and the job recovers by itself (2 attempts)
a document the user deleted stays deleted after the next synchronisation
the audit log records the connector, synchronisations, ingested records, the probe and the retry, without content or credentials
no credential and no record content appears in the audit log or the job list

integrations.note: CSV: real HTTP pull from mock-services/records. Webhooks: real HMAC-signed deliveries to the API; adversarial deliveries are deliberate negative tests. Signing secrets are run-only and never recorded.

apex-industrial.step: the administrator registers a CSV connector through the public API
an invalid CSV configuration is rejected at creation (422)
a supervisor starts the CSV synchronisation: 202 with a durable QUEUED job
the worker fetched the CSV file and ingested every row: 7 records created
the records mock served the CSV to the authenticated connector
the rows are retrievable with their record id as provenance
a repeated CSV synchronisation is idempotent: every row unchanged
the live probe validates the CSV source header (nothing ingested)
the administrator provisions a webhook endpoint (only the NAME of the secret variable is supplied; no secret is returned)
an engineer cannot provision endpoints (403)
a correctly signed delivery is acknowledged 202 QUEUED (durably queued, not yet processed)
the worker processed the delivery through the ingestion pipeline: 1 record created
the delivered content is retrievable by this tenant and not by the other tenant
a wrong secret and a tampered body are rejected with the same 401 invalid_signature
a validly signed but stale delivery is rejected by the timestamp window (401)
replaying a received delivery id is rejected (409 webhook_replayed)
an oversized body is refused (413, or the connection is closed by the server while it is still being sent) and a non-JSON content type is refused (415)
a signed delivery that can never be processed is rejected after authentication (422)
a later delivery with changed content becomes a new document version
secret rotation: both secrets work during the overlap, the old one is rejected after it is dropped
another tenant cannot see or change this endpoint
a disabled endpoint rejects even a correctly signed delivery (401)
the audit log records endpoint changes and every authenticated delivery outcome
no signing secret, API key or delivery content appears in the audit log, job list or endpoint list
